name: section-store
description: Build and change Section Store bundles and cart drawers in your Shopify store.

interface.longDescription:
Section Store is a Shopify app with 700+ theme sections, product bundles and a cart drawer. This plugin lets ChatGPT build and change its bundles and cart drawer in your store.

Bundles are offers on your product pages: quantity breaks, buy X get Y, mix and match, free gifts and add-on upsells. Shopify applies them at checkout.

The cart drawer slides out when a shopper adds a product. It holds a reward bar for free shipping or free gifts, product and order upsells, trust badges and the checkout button.

What ChatGPT can do:
• List and read your bundles and carts.
• Find products and collections in your store.
• Create, change, copy and delete bundles and carts.
• Switch bundles and carts on and off.
• Render a preview of a bundle or cart as shoppers will see it.
• Search the Section Store help docs.
• Undo its own changes for 30 days.

How it stays safe:
• You approve the connection inside Section Store in your Shopify admin. It reaches only that store.
• New bundles start off. A change to a live bundle or cart waits for your OK, and ChatGPT lists the changes first.
• It can't edit your products, prices, orders or theme, and it reads no customer or order data.
• Disconnect any time: in Section Store, click Manage next to Build with AI.

Who it's for: Shopify merchants who use Section Store.
defaultPrompt: Make a quantity break bundle for my best seller: buy 1, 2 or 3 with bigger savings.
Add a free shipping goal at $50 to my cart drawer and show me a preview.
Which of my bundles are on right now, and what do they offer?

positive.prompt: Which of my bundles are on right now, and what discounts do they give?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the store's bundles that are switched on, with each deal's offer. It matches the Bundles page in the Section Store app. Nothing changes.

positive.description: Create a bundle that starts off
positive.prompt: Make a quantity break bundle for one of my products: buy 1, 2 or 3, with 10% off 2 and 15% off 3. Leave it off.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a product, creates a bundle with three deals (no saving, 10% off, 15% off) and reports that it is off. Shoppers see no change.

positive.prompt: Render a preview of that bundle on the product page and give me the preview link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to a preview page that shows the new bundle as shoppers will see it. The bundle stays off.

positive.prompt: How do I show bundles on my product page? Check the Section Store help docs.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from Section Store's help articles and links the article it used. Nothing in the store changes.

positive.prompt: Undo the bundle you just made.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the change it made, asks before running the undo, then deletes the test bundle it created. Other bundles stay as they were.

negative.prompt: Change the price of my best-selling product to $20.

negative.description: Bulk delete without a clear yes

review.commerce_description: Section Store sells nothing inside ChatGPT and takes no payments. Its tools set up a merchant's bundle offers and cart drawer. Shopify applies them at the store's own checkout.

publication.release_notes: First release: bundle and cart drawer tools for Shopify stores that use Section Store.
